dodont.do.li1: Be clear and specific: Make sure your prompt is clear and free of vague wording so AI can accurately understand what you need.
dodont.do.li2: Be concise and include relevant context: Use simple, direct language while providing the background information AI needs to respond more precisely.
dodont.do.li3: Use natural language: Avoid overly complex or stiff phrasing so AI can more easily understand your intent.
dodont.do.li4: Break down complex tasks: For highly complex tasks, split them into a series of smaller prompts to improve how well AI handles them.
dodont.do.li5: Verify and test AI results: Make sure AI-generated content meets your needs, and make any necessary adjustments and corrections.
dodont.do.li6: Refine with follow-up prompts: Continuously improve the quality of AI's responses through iteration and additional instructions.
dodont.dont.li2: Don't add too much irrelevant information or detail to your prompt, as it can confuse AI. Don't include confidential or proprietary information in your prompt.
dodont.dont.li3: Avoid jargon, acronyms, and complex language.
dodont.dont.li4: Avoid asking AI to perform multiple tasks or a very complex task in a single prompt.
dodont.dont.li5: Don't blindly assume the output is error-free.
dodont.dont.li6: If the result isn't quite right, don't start over with a brand-new prompt.
dodont.heading: Best practices for writing AI prompts

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: If you can't find an answer to your question, please reach out to us at: sales@titansoft.com.sg.
faq.q1.answer:
• Rovo includes features that interoperate with third-party products. For example, you can use connectors to connect third-party products to Rovo. Before connecting a third-party product, we recommend reviewing the types of data that product stores and confirming that the data connection complies with your internal data usage policies and practices.
  • Connecting Rovo to a third-party product may allow that third party to access the information you choose to use with their product, and your use of the third-party product and the information you share will be governed by their terms and policies (including their privacy policy). For example, if you use an Agent purchased through the Atlassian Marketplace, your use of that agent will be governed by the third party's terms and policies.
faq.q1.question: Interoperability with third-party products
faq.q10.answer:
1. Admin-managed connectors: Disabled by default and must be connected manually by an org admin; once enabled, they respect existing permissions and extend the capabilities of Agents, Search, and Chat.
  2. Smart Link connectors: Require no admin setup and display results based on each individual's permissions and history.
faq.q10.question: Are Rovo's third-party connectors enabled by default?
faq.q2.answer:
• Rovo syncs access controls and permission settings from connected third-party products and your Atlassian products to ensure users can only see content they're authorized to access.
  • Because Rovo relies on the permissions you've set, you should review—and remind users to review—the permission settings of a third-party product before connecting it.
  • For example, if you connect Google Drive to Rovo, users need to sign in and connect their Atlassian account to Google Drive before they can see any Google Drive search results in Rovo. Once authorized, users will be able to see the public and private documents they already have access to.
faq.q2.question: Permission management
faq.q3.answer:
• For admin-managed connectors, Rovo "listens" for content deletion events and updates the Rovo index accordingly. For example, once the Rovo index is updated, content deleted from a connected third-party product will no longer appear in Rovo results.
  • For Smart Link connectors, links to deleted content may still appear in search results. However, if a user clicks a link to deleted content—or a link they no longer have access to—the link will show as broken.
  • If an organization admin disconnects a third-party product from Rovo, Rovo will delete the indexed content from that product within 30 days. For GitHub content, however, deletion works differently. Because GitHub data is integrated through the GitHub for Jira app, data is only deleted when you disconnect GitHub from Rovo and uninstall the GitHub for Jira app.
faq.q3.question: Deleted data
faq.q4.answer:
• Rovo indexes the entire workspace of a connected third-party product (for example, your whole Google Drive or SharePoint workspace). At this time, you can't narrow the indexing scope further (for example, indexing only specific folders in Google Drive), but we may consider adding this capability in the future.
  • To provide the Rovo service, Rovo stores document content from third-party products along with related usage data. Rovo also stores documents' permission settings to ensure only content a user is authorized to access is shown.
faq.q4.question: Data usage
faq.q5.answer: • Rovo and Atlassian Intelligence have completed SOC 2 and ISO 27001 external assessments and compliance certifications. Going forward, Rovo and Atlassian Intelligence will be part of Atlassian's annual compliance audits.
faq.q5.question: SOC 2 and ISO 27001
faq.q6.answer:
• Rovo uses OpenAI LLMs as well as Atlassian self-hosted open-source models such as the Llama family and Mixtral, and third-party hosted models such as OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini.
  • The LLM providers Rovo uses do not use your inputs and outputs to improve their services. Neither OpenAI nor any other LLM provider will retain your input and output data.
faq.q6.question: Large language models (LLMs)
faq.q7.answer:
• If a user is permitted to install the Rovo browser extension, they can use Rovo Chat and Agents on any public web page (for example, Wikipedia) or any web page connected to Rovo through a connector (for example, SharePoint). For instance, if you connect Rovo to SharePoint and view a Word document in your browser, you can ask Rovo Chat to summarize that Word document's content.
  • In addition, the extension reads (but does not store) the content of private Google Docs in order to provide inline definition access in the browser. Document content is only sent to Atlassian to detect definable words, and is not stored or sent to any third-party model (such as OpenAI).
faq.q7.question: Browser extension
faq.q8.answer:
• Once you set up a connector, Rovo establishes a secure synchronization with the third-party product. When new content is created or deleted in that product, the relevant information is synced to Rovo.
  • This means that restricted data in the third-party product (such as private files or folders in Google Drive) can only be viewed and used in Rovo by users who already have access to that content in the third-party product.
faq.q8.question: How permissions stay in sync
faq.q9.answer:
1. AI features can be enabled or disabled manually for each product, but non-AI Rovo features (such as Rovo Search) cannot be disabled.
  2. You can restrict which data AI/Rovo can access, though Rovo Search, Studio, and Bookmarks are platform-level features that are always on.
  3. You can set allow/block lists for Google Drive and Microsoft SharePoint to restrict indexed content.
  4. Application data within Rovo's scope can reside in a selected AWS region for Data Residency.

prompt.heading: The building blocks of writing AI prompts
prompt.p1.body: The elements and level of detail to include in a great AI prompt should be tailored to the complexity of the task you want AI to perform. If you're asking AI a simple question, you can use the same natural language you'd use when asking a colleague. A well-crafted generative AI prompt should include the following elements:
prompt.p1.li1: Role: Define the role AI should take on.
prompt.p1.li2: Job: Clearly state the task you want AI to perform.
prompt.p1.li3: Context: Provide useful background information or context.
prompt.p1.title: Key elements
prompt.p2.li1: The role defines the perspective or persona AI should assume when generating a response. This helps AI tailor its output to the desired context and tone.
prompt.p2.li2: A role can be a person with: expertise in a specific subject ("Act as a Jira reporting expert."), a unique perspective or opinion ("As a Confluence admin, explain…"), or a particular profession ("Take on the role of a marketing analyst."). You can ask AI to play multiple roles (even fictional ones) to provide the ideal combination of perspective and expertise you need.
prompt.p2.title: Role
prompt.p3.li1: In this part, you'll use action verbs such as "explain," "write," "analyze," and "list" to clearly instruct AI to perform a specific action or provide the information you need.
prompt.p3.li2: The more specific your instructions, the more precise the results AI generates. In addition, giving AI clear rules or guidelines helps ensure the output meets your expectations and reduces the need for follow-up corrections. This phrasing makes sentences flow more smoothly and professionally, and emphasizes how important clear instructions are to getting the results you want. If there are other details you'd like to add or emphasize, you can always adjust the content!
prompt.p3.title: Job
prompt.p4.li1: Providing background information helps AI understand the context or situation related to the task. This might include why you need the information, who's involved, and any relevant background details. Providing context ensures AI's response fits your specific needs and situation more closely. Context may include:
prompt.p4.ol1: The background or larger picture driving this task
prompt.p4.ol2: The target audience for the output
prompt.p4.ol3: The purpose or intent behind your request
prompt.p4.ol4: The intended use of the result
prompt.p4.title: Context
prompt.p5.li1: Beyond the essential components, there are optional elements that can improve the quality of an AI prompt and, in turn, the AI's responses. These elements aren't required in every prompt, but they can be helpful in certain situations.
prompt.p5.li2: Depending on the type and complexity of the task you ask AI to perform, a high-quality prompt might include the following additional elements:
prompt.p5.ol1: Format: Specify the expected format of the output.
prompt.p5.ol2: Tone: Define the writing style or emotional tone of AI's response.
prompt.p5.ol3: Source: Mention any specific sources you'd like AI to reference.
prompt.p5.ol4: Example: Provide good examples to guide AI toward output that meets your needs.
prompt.p5.title: Additional elements

videos.heading: Rovo AI in action
videos.v1.body: With Rovo Bookmarks search, businesses and teams can leverage AI-driven search optimization to manage key information more efficiently and ensure important content appears first in search results. This not only improves the search experience but also significantly boosts productivity.
videos.v1.title: Get the answer directly—not just another link or file
videos.v2.body: With Rovo Chat, businesses can easily manage internal knowledge and enable AI-assisted content creation and information analysis to speed up team operations. If you're looking for an efficient AI knowledge management and creation tool, Rovo Chat is the best choice!
videos.v2.title: Let Rovo help create content, just like talking with a person
videos.v3.body: Rovo integrates Atlassian tools (such as Jira and Confluence) and other SaaS applications to provide a visual view of organizational goals, knowledge, teams, and work status. Through real-time progress tracking and conversational interaction, Rovo helps teams quickly grasp project status and anticipate potential risks. AI analyzes large volumes of data to identify trends and optimize decisions, while fostering team collaboration and breaking down information silos. Through data integration, task automation, and risk prediction, Rovo AI boosts productivity and project success rates.
videos.v3.title: Rovo helps teams boost efficiency and reduce project risk
videos.v4.body: Rovo can help fill in missing Acceptance Criteria (AC) by analyzing existing requirement descriptions, user stories, or similar cases to provide reasonable, concrete acceptance criteria. This ensures the development team has a clear understanding of requirements, reduces miscommunication, and improves the consistency and quality of product development.
videos.v4.title: Rovo helps write product acceptance criteria
videos.v5.body: With Rovo external link search, developers can access Jira or Confluence task information more smoothly within their existing workflow, enabling more efficient software development and a better collaboration experience.
videos.v5.title: Rovo and GitHub Copilot work together to boost development efficiency
videos.v6.li1: Rovo Agent helps teams quickly respond to all kinds of challenges. Through in-depth data analysis, it effectively summarizes and focuses on the core of a problem, helping teams list out solutions point by point based on historical data. Rovo not only helps teams quickly find the right person to assist, but also efficiently reports on problem-resolution progress and provides customers with a complete summary of the solution.
videos.v6.li2: With Rovo Agent, you can significantly shorten resolution times, reduce potential risks, and ultimately improve customer satisfaction and trust in your service. Whether you're improving internal collaboration or strengthening customer relationships, Rovo Agent is a capable partner for solving your business's problems.
videos.v6.title: Rovo Agent boosts team efficiency and customer satisfaction
videos.v7.li1: With Rovo Agent, businesses can seamlessly integrate everyday communication tools like Slack and Microsoft Teams with JSM (Jira Service Management), letting Rovo Agent execute commands and reply to users in real time. This integration is not only No code and dramatically improves response speed, but also lets you quantify inquiry data and analyze answer quality afterward to further optimize service management.
videos.v7.li2: Whether you're improving internal collaboration or strengthening the customer support experience, Rovo Agent is the best choice for your business's digital transformation, helping you solve problems more intelligently and efficiently.
videos.v7.title: Mobile-ready: Rovo Agent seamlessly integrates Slack, Teams, and JSM to auto-reply to messages and boost collaboration
